name: Jeera Krunch
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Whole Wheat Flour (Atta), Sugar, Refined Palm Oil, Invert Sugar Syrup, Iodised Salt, Liquid Glucose, Edible Starch, Raising Agents (INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii)), Emulsifier (INS 322), Acidity Regulator (INS 450), Spices (Jeera, Kalonji). Contains Permitted Synthetic Food Colour (INS 102) and Added Flavours (Artificial Flavouring Substances - Milk & Butter).
